name: night-differential-overtime-week
summary: Illinois worker at $18.00/h, billed at $26.00/h, works 9 hours Monday to Friday (45 h). The rate card pays a Night shift differential of $1.50/h on Wednesday to Friday (27 h) and bills it at $2.00/h. A differential is in the regular rate (29 C.F.R. § 778.207(b)): straight-time earnings 45 h × $18.00 = $810.00 plus 27 h × $1.50 = $40.50 is $850.50, ÷ 45 h = a regular rate of $18.90. The last 5 hours (Friday) are overtime at $18.00 + ½ × $18.90 = $27.45/h: 5 h × $27.45 = $137.25. Pay: 40 h × $18.00 = $720.00, overtime $137.25, differential 27 h × $1.50 = $40.50; total $897.75 (= $850.50 + ½ × $18.90 × 5 h). Bill: 40 h × $26.00 = $1,040.00, overtime 5 h × $39.00 = $195.00, differential 27 h × $2.00 = $54.00.

payLines.explain: Regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $18.00/h = 72000¢ exactly → $720.00. Rule straight_time: hours up to the 40h 00m weekly threshold in the workweek starting 2026-10-05.

Overtime: 5h 00m (300 min) × $27.45/h ($18.00 + 0.5 × regular rate $18.90/h) = 13725¢ exactly → $137.25. Rule weekly_overtime: 45h 00m worked in the workweek starting 2026-10-05 is 5h 00m over the 40h 00m threshold (Illinois Minimum Wage Law, 820 ILCS 105/4a(1) — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate; Fair Labor Standards Act, 29 U.S.C. § 207(a)(1); 29 C.F.R. Part 778 — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate). Regular rate: ($810.00 earned at straight time + $40.50 Night shift differential) ÷ 45h 00m worked = $18.90/h, used unrounded (29 C.F.R. § 778.115; § 778.111(a); 29 C.F.R. § 778.207(b)).

Night shift differential: 27h 00m (1620 min) × $1.50/h = 4050¢ exactly → $40.50. Rule shift_differential: the rate card pays a Night differential of $1.50/h for each hour of these shifts on 2026-10-07, 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; it is part of the regular rate (29 C.F.R. § 778.207(b)).

billLines.explain: Billed regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $26.00/h = 104000¢ exactly → $1,040.00. Bill rate from the rate card.
Billed overtime: 5h 00m (300 min) × $39.00/h (1.5 × $26.00 bill rate) = 19500¢ exactly → $195.00. Client bills overtime at the rate-card overtime multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.
Night shift differential billed: 27h 00m (1620 min) × $2.00/h = 5400¢ exactly → $54.00. The rate card bills the Night differential at $2.00/h.
